headword: チャンネル{登録|とうろく}

definitions.gloss: channel subscription; subscribing to a channel
definitions.explanation: Subscribing to a content creator's channel on a video platform such as YouTube, so that the viewer is notified of new uploads and the channel appears in their subscription feed. Heard constantly in YouTuber videos in the standard appeal to viewers.

examples.japanese: チャンネル{登録|とうろく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧お{願|ねが}いします。
⟦{面白|おもしろ}い→面白い：00589_omoshiroi⟧⟦{動画|どうが}→動画：04443_douga⟧だった⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、チャンネル{登録|とうろく}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The video was interesting, so I subscribed to the channel.

examples.japanese: チャンネル{登録|とうろく}{者数|しゃすう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧10{万人|まんにん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{超|こ}える→超える：01942_koeru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{銀|ぎん}→銀：02651_gin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{盾|たて}→盾：03430_tate⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦もらえる→もらう：00520_morau⟧。
examples.english: When the number of channel subscribers exceeds 100,000, you receive a silver play button.

notes:
A set phrase coined with the spread of YouTube in Japan. The full appeal phrase チャンネル{登録|とうろく}⟦よろしくお{願|ねが}いします→よろしくお願いします：23566_yoroshikuonegaishimasu⟧ is one of the most-heard sentences in Japanese YouTube videos.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- チャンネル{登録|とうろく}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to subscribe to the channel
- チャンネル{登録|とうろく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{解除|かいじょ}する→解除する：26843_kaijosuru⟧: to unsubscribe from the channel
- チャンネル{登録|とうろく}{者|しゃ}: subscriber(s) (of a channel)
- チャンネル{登録|とうろく}{者数|しゃすう}: subscriber count
- チャンネル{登録|とうろく}⟦ボタン→ボタン：02963_botan⟧: subscribe button
- チャンネル{登録|とうろく}⟦よろしくお{願|ねが}いします→よろしくお願いします：23566_yoroshikuonegaishimasu⟧: 'Please subscribe!' (standard YouTuber closing line)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{購読|こうどく}→購読：04468_koudoku⟧: subscription (reading/content) — often used for paid subscriptions to magazines, newspapers, or online publications
- ⟦{定期購読|ていきこうどく}→定期購読：16116_teikikoudoku⟧: regular subscription (print or digital) — emphasizes recurring payment
- ⟦フォロー→フォロー：04730_foroo⟧: follow — used on social media (Twitter, Instagram); a lighter, non-notification-based version of following

USAGE:
チャンネル{登録|とうろく} is specifically used for video channels (YouTube and similar platforms). For social media following, ⟦フォロー→フォロー：04730_foroo⟧ is used instead. For paid subscriptions, ⟦サブスク→サブスク：05396_sabusuku⟧ (short for ⟦サブスクリプション→サブスクリプション：08617_sabusukuripushon⟧) or ⟦{定期購読|ていきこうどく}→定期購読：16116_teikikoudoku⟧ is more common.
